objects.summary: Early reusable sub-agent architecture: shared CLAUDE.md context, role-specific model/tool dispatch, frozen universes, orchestrator-owned commits and anti-snooping. Useful precursor to later efficiency rules, but historical agent documentation is not current authority.

Historical cross-market robustness task for an already-selected LogitL2+overlay pipeline across Russell 2000, S&P 500 and DAX. It freezes protocol/variants and success criteria but is an instruction, not evidence that those tests were executed or validly promoted.

Mechanical public-data acquisition/validation agent for long OHLC histories, with explicit no-invention, new-file-only, quality checks and reruns of A/B/C. It is historically useful for reproducibility but embeds a legacy workflow and cannot prove data admissibility or current scientific authority.

Historical Step-D design asks for vol-targeting plus extreme-vol cut, frozen variants, MDD/return success criteria and anti-snooping. It explicitly reuses existing volatility code. Its premise that volatility forecasting implies an exploitable risk-management edge is a historical hypothesis/instruction, not a current proven edge.
Historical reporting agent that must source all numbers from results files and communicate profitability/risks honestly. It contains no independent evidence and no execution authority.

Historical instruction to combine LogitL2, meta-labeling and overlay under a frozen five-variant protocol. It assumes previously selected components and defines a drawdown objective, but does not prove that the integrated pipeline was executed, qualified or economically superior.

Historical meta-labeling implementation task with embargo, frozen primary signal and explicit accounting for an additional trial. Strong anti-leakage intent, but its statement that no new SPA is needed is a methodological assertion from that phase, not current authority.
Historical eight-variant ensemble/overlay comparison with fixed signals and DSR accounting. It is a preregistration-style task surface, not proof of cross-model robustness.
Historical synthesis-only agent explicitly forbidden from recalculating or embellishing results. It is a good evidence-reporting separation pattern but carries no scientific claim itself.

Concise state/timeline integrity law: causal ordering, restart/idempotence, multi-strategy ownership, final-state limits and consistent price bases. Exact bytes recur across 13 historical snapshots, showing this invariant survived many architecture branches.

Testing law requires dangerous-boundary failure modes, restart/replay fixtures, timeline counterexamples, final transformed-state checks and explicit separation of synthetic fixtures from market evidence. This is durable methodological value, not runtime proof.

Earlier quant-audit skill asks for independent non-overlapping review angles and a single deduplicated verdict, with smallest regression proof and no code editing. It predates explicit authority/SHA resolution.

Later quant-audit revision adds current Blue governance, frozen candidate SHA and branch-specific mission resolution before review. This is a meaningful maturity delta: review subject identity becomes explicit rather than inferred from branch/state prose.

Compact handoff contract: exact HEAD/branch/PR, completed capability, tests actually run, recomputed results if any, limits/blockers and authoritative files; explicitly forbids claiming enums/docs/stubs/unexercised paths as capabilities. Directly addresses restart and narrative inflation.
Earlier orientation skill reconstructs branch/HEAD/mission from North Star and current mission with bounded reads, avoiding whole-repo re-exploration. It is an anti-restart precursor.

Later orientation revision strengthens authority routing: current Blue governance and exact branch handoff outrank STATE/brief/current-mission helpers; exact CI and proof domain are required. This closes stale-router/branch-name authority errors seen elsewhere in history.

Earlier proof skill requires invariant-by-invariant PASS/FAIL/UNPROVEN, behavioral/adversarial tests and persistent-state comparison rather than summary. It is independent verification guidance, not evidence of a specific milestone.

Later proof revision explicitly binds every proof claim to exact candidate SHA/proof domain and current governance before verification. This directly addresses historical cross-SHA qualification leakage.

Very compact research-law version: causal timestamps, preregistration, consumed holdouts, costs/benchmark/perturbations, explicit decision and judge-not-tuner separation. Scientifically useful but too narrow to solve repository continuity on its own.

Mature project contract centralizes restart-safe recovery: remote reconciliation, VERIFIED/REPORTED/STALE/UNKNOWN distinctions, construction-vs-qualification dimensions, REUSE>CONNECT>REPAIR>BUILD, bounded challenge, decision-relevance parking, exact durable updates, no restart after interruption, permanent authority fences and GitHub-as-truth. It directly incorporates many lessons exposed by the forensic history; historical docs are explicitly non-authoritative when superseded.

cross_object_findings.finding: The early .claude/agents design already tried to reduce tokens and duplicate exploration through shared CLAUDE.md context and frozen protocols, but several agents embed historical results/selected variants as premises. Without exact SHA/proof-domain reconciliation, this efficiency mechanism could also propagate stale conclusions.

Successive quant-audit/orient/proof revisions add exact governance, candidate SHA and proof-domain binding. The mature AGENTS.md then adds remote reconciliation, NO_CHANGE_REQUIRED/PARK/BLOCK/UNKNOWN, durable update verification and interruption recovery. These are direct process corrections to observed rework modes.

State-integrity, testing and several skill blobs appear byte-identically across many owner-recovery snapshots. This demonstrates semantic continuity across divergent branches and cautions against treating branch divergence as capability loss.

The backtest/overlay/meta-labeling/ensemble/integrated-pipeline agent files define intended experiments and success criteria, but none by themselves prove execution, qualification, integration or edge. They remain historical intent unless linked to primary result evidence.
Bundle 0001 adds process/history understanding but reveals no new current code/runtime repair requirement. Continue semantic reading.
